entries.name: extrude.block.area
entries.description: Get the area of a block.

entries.name: extrude.block.block
entries.description: Get a block neighbor. The neighbor is the block attached to the source block at the edge with index i. Edge indices on a block start at 1.

entries.name: extrude.block.center
entries.description: Get the center point of a block. For regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks returns the coordinates of the geometric center of the block and for irregular blocks return the geometric center of the largest zone in the block.

entries.name: extrude.block.check
entries.description: Get the validity of a block. Possible return values: 1 = valid, 0 = not valid.

entries.name: extrude.block.countzones
entries.description: Get the total number of zones in the block.

entries.name: extrude.block.create.at
entries.description: Create a meshed block from the edges surrounding the point at position v, using the current meshing parameters (the 7.0 spelling of sketch.block.create.at).

entries.name: extrude.block.create.auto
entries.description: Create blocks automatically from the closed edge loops of the extrusion set, using the current meshing parameters; returns true on success (the 7.0 spelling of sketch.block.create.auto).

entries.name: extrude.block.edge
entries.description: Get a pointer to a block edge. Edge indices on a block start at 1.

entries.name: extrude.block.extra
entries.description: Get/sets the value stored in the ith extra variable array of block bp.

entries.name: extrude.block.find
entries.description: Get the block with ID i.

entries.name: extrude.block.flip
entries.description: Get the “flipped” state of a block edge.

entries.name: extrude.block.grid.pos
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: extrude.block.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to extrude block b in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: extrude.block.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the extrude block in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.block.id
entries.description: Get the block ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: extrude.block.irregular.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of the block. For irregular blocks (blocks with unstructured mesh), this will always return 1486667164.

entries.name: extrude.block.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the extrude block and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.block.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all blocks in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.block.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any block in the set sp. The next block created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: extrude.block.multiplier
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh. Multiplier for irregular blocks is always 1.

entries.name: extrude.block.next.block
entries.description: Get the next block connected to the edge with local index i within the source block bp. This can be used to iterate through all blocks connected to an edge using the extrude.block.next.index function.

entries.name: extrude.block.next.index
entries.description: Get local index ir of an extrude edge within the next block attached to this edge (note: the same edge has local index i within the source block p).

entries.name: extrude.block.nodes
entries.description: Get the list of 2D vectors wich correspond to the positions of the nodes of an element with local index i within a block bp. The index can vary from 1 to extrude.block.countzones.

entries.name: extrude.block.num
entries.description: Get the total number of blocks in the set sp.

entries.name: extrude.block.param.pos
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: extrude.block.point
entries.description: Get a point (vertex) of a block. Points indices start with 1 and must not be more than the number of vertices on the boundaries of the block.

entries.name: extrude.block.regular.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of the block. For regular blocks (3- or 4- sided blocks with structured mesh), this will always return 1286571647.

entries.name: extrude.block.size
entries.description: Get the number of edges on all the boundaries of a block (including internal boundaries, if any). This will equal the number of points on the block.

entries.name: extrude.block.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For blocks, this will always return 1486667202.

entries.name: extrude.block.zones.i
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: extrude.block.zones.j
entries.description: The function only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh.

entries.name: extrude.edge.blocked
entries.description: Get block attachment state of an edge. Possible return values: 1 = there is at least one block attached to the edge; 0 = no block is attached to the edge.

entries.name: extrude.edge.blocks
entries.description: Get the list of all blocks connected to the edge e

entries.name: extrude.edge.center
entries.description: Get the position (2D vector) of an edge midpoint.

entries.name: extrude.edge.curve
entries.description: Get edge curvature state. Possible return values: 1 = the edge is curved; 0 = edge is linear.

entries.name: extrude.edge.direction
entries.description: Get the direction of an edge. The return is the 2D vector from point1 to point2 of the edge.

entries.name: extrude.edge.extra
entries.description: Get/sets the value stored in the ith extra variable array of edge e.

entries.name: extrude.edge.find
entries.description: Get the edge with ID i.

entries.name: extrude.edge.grid.ratio
entries.description: Get/set the ratio setting of an edge. See extrude edge ratio.

entries.name: extrude.edge.grid.ratio.isolate
entries.description: The option only applies to the edges which form regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks.

entries.name: extrude.edge.grid.size
entries.description: Get/set the number of zones (grid size) on edge.

entries.name: extrude.edge.gridpos
entries.description: Get the position of a grid point. Returns a position (2D vector). Grid point indices range from 0 to extrude.edge.grid.size.

entries.name: extrude.edge.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to edge e in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: extrude.edge.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the edge in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.edge.id
entries.description: Get the edge ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: extrude.edge.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the edge and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.edge.length
entries.description: Get the length of an edge.

entries.name: extrude.edge.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all edges in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.edge.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any edge in the set sp. The next edge created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: extrude.edge.next.edge
entries.description: Get the next edge connected to the point with local index i within the source edge ep. This can be used to iterate through all edges connected to a point using the extrude.edge.next.index function.

entries.name: extrude.edge.next.index
entries.description: Get local index inext of an extrude point within the next edge attached to this point (note: the same point has local index i within the source edge ep).

entries.name: extrude.edge.num
entries.description: Get the total number of edges in the set sp.

entries.name: extrude.edge.parampos
entries.description: Get the position of parameterized location v. Returns a 2D vector (x,y). Values of f should range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: extrude.edge.point
entries.description: Get a point of an edge. The edge endpoint index may be 1 or 2.

entries.name: extrude.edge.poly.add
entries.description: Add a control point. The point is added at position v. If the edge type is simple line, the edge type will be changed to polyline type.

entries.name: extrude.edge.poly.delete
entries.description: Delete control point i of an edge. Control point indices start at 1 (the 7.0 spelling of sketch.edge.poly.delete).

entries.name: extrude.edge.poly.localu
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of an edge control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: extrude.edge.poly.localv
entries.description: Get/set the local parametric f coordinate of an edge control point. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: extrude.edge.poly.point
entries.description: Get/set the position of a control point on an edge. Control point indices start at 1.

entries.name: extrude.edge.poly.size
entries.description: Get the number of the control points on an edge.

entries.name: extrude.edge.simple
entries.description: Get the control point usage of an edge. Possible return values are: true = edge is linear, has no control points; false = edge has control points.

entries.name: extrude.edge.start.block
entries.description: Get the first block on the list of blocks attached to an edge.

entries.name: extrude.edge.start.index
entries.description: Get the local index of the edge's start point (7.0 extruder; sketch.segment.start.index in 9.x).

entries.name: extrude.edge.type
entries.description: Get/set the edge type. Possible return/assignment values are: 0 = simple, 1 = polyline, 2 = circlearcs, 3 = spline.

entries.name: extrude.edge.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For edges, this will always return 1286571528.

entries.name: extrude.point.blocks
entries.description: Get the list of all blocks connected to the point p

entries.name: extrude.point.edges
entries.description: Get the list of all edges connected to the point p

entries.name: extrude.point.extra
entries.description: Get/sets the value stored in the ith extra variable array of point p.

entries.name: extrude.point.find
entries.description: Get the point with ID i.

entries.name: extrude.point.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to point p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: extrude.point.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the point in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.point.id
entries.description: Get the point ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: extrude.point.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the point and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.point.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all points in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.point.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any point in the set sp. The next point created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: extrude.point.num
entries.description: Get the total number of points in the set sp.

entries.name: extrude.point.pos
entries.description: Get/set the position of a point.

entries.name: extrude.point.start.edge
entries.description: Get the first edge on the list of edges connected to a point.

entries.name: extrude.point.start.index
entries.description: Get local index i of point n within the first edge attached to the point. This can be used to iterate through all edges attached to a node with the extrude.point.start.edge, extrude.edge.next.edge and extrude.edge.next.index functions.

entries.name: extrude.point.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For points, this will always return 1286571333.

entries.name: extrude.segment.count
entries.description: Get the number segments in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.segment.grid.ratio
entries.description: Get/set ratio setting for the segment grid. See the ratio keyword of the extrude segment index command.

entries.name: extrude.segment.grid.size
entries.description: Get/set the number of zones along a segment.

entries.name: extrude.segment.group
entries.description: Get the group name assigned to segment i of extrude set p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: extrude.segment.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the segment i of extrude set p and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.segment.length
entries.description: Get/set the length of a segment.

entries.name: extrude.segment.node.add
entries.description: Add a segment node by position. Possible return values are: 1 = success, 0 = failure. An existing segment is split at the location f. If the location falls past the end of the extrusion’s extent, a new segment is added.

entries.name: extrude.segment.node.delete
entries.description: Delete a segment (node).

entries.name: extrude.segment.node.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to segment node i of extrude set p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: extrude.segment.node.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the segment node i in extrude set p and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: extrude.segment.node.pos
entries.description: Get segment node position.

entries.name: extrude.segment.node.removegroup
entries.description: Remove a segment node group assignment. Possible return values are: 1 = success, 0 = failure.

entries.name: extrude.segment.removegroup
entries.description: Remove a segment group assignment. Possible return values are: 1 = success, 0 = failure.

entries.name: extrude.set.axis.n
entries.description: The function only applies to 3D case (when 3D zones are generated from the Extruder).

entries.name: extrude.set.axis.u
entries.description: Get/set the u-axis. This axis is the direction of x in the extruder 2D coordinate system when the model is extruded.

entries.name: extrude.set.axis.un
entries.description: Set the local u- and n-axes of the extrusion set from the two vectors given; the third axis follows. Returns true on success (7.0 extruder; the 9.x axes are u, v, w).

entries.name: extrude.set.axis.uv
entries.description: Set the local u- and v-axes of the extrusion set from the two vectors given; the third axis follows. Returns true on success (7.0 extruder; sketch.set.axis.uv in 9.x).

entries.name: extrude.set.axis.v
entries.description: Get/set the v-axis. This axis is the direction of y in the extruder 2D coordinate system when the model is extruded.

entries.name: extrude.set.axis.vn
entries.description: Set the local v- and n-axes of the extrusion set from the two vectors given; the third axis follows. Returns true on success (7.0 extruder; the 9.x axes are u, v, w).

entries.name: extrude.set.badzones
entries.description: Checks whether or not any elements in the set have bad geometries based on the extruder criteria (the check is performed for quadrilateral elements only).

entries.name: extrude.set.block.create
entries.description: Create a block from points with ID i1, i2, i3, etc.

entries.name: extrude.set.block.delete
entries.description: Delete a block.

entries.name: extrude.set.block.find
entries.description: Get a block by ID.

entries.name: extrude.set.block.list
entries.description: Get a list of all blocks in set sp.

entries.name: extrude.set.block.near
entries.description: Get the block nearest to a position. Null is returned if no block is found.

entries.name: extrude.set.block.size
entries.description: Get the number of blocks in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.set.create
entries.description: Create an extrude set. Returns a pointer to the the created set.

entries.name: extrude.set.delete
entries.description: Delete an extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.combine
entries.description: Combines a set of edges into a single curved edge ep.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.create
entries.description: Create an edge from two points. The points may be provided by ID or by pointer.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.delete
entries.description: Delete an edge.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.find
entries.description: Get an edge by ID.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.list
entries.description: Get a list of all edges in set sp.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.near
entries.description: Get the edge nearest a position. Returns null if no edge is found.

entries.name: extrude.set.edge.size
entries.description: Get number of edges in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.set.find
entries.description: Get an extrude set by name or ID.

entries.name: extrude.set.id
entries.description: Get the ID of an extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.set.list
entries.description: Get a list of extrude sets.

entries.name: extrude.set.metadata.find
entries.description: Get a metadata value from a metadata key.

entries.name: extrude.set.metadata.key
entries.description: Get a metadata key from a metadata container index.

entries.name: extrude.set.metadata.size
entries.description: Get the number of MetaData objects in the Metadata container.

entries.name: extrude.set.metadata.value
entries.description: Get a metadata value from a metadata key. In place of s1 an index position in the metadata container may be supplied.

entries.name: extrude.set.name
entries.description: Get the name of an extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.set.origin
entries.description: Get/set the origin of the extrusion transformation. When extruded, the extrusion coordinate system origin (0,0) is mapped to zones coordinate origin specified by vector v.

entries.name: extrude.set.point.create
entries.description: Create a point at a position.

entries.name: extrude.set.point.delete
entries.description: Delete a point.

entries.name: extrude.set.point.find
entries.description: Get a point by ID.

entries.name: extrude.set.point.list
entries.description: Get a list of all points in set sp.

entries.name: extrude.set.point.near
entries.description: Get the point nearest a position. Returns null if no point is found.

entries.name: extrude.set.point.size
entries.description: Get number of points in the extrude set.

entries.name: extrude.set.region.element.num
entries.description: Get the number of elements in a block with ID i.

entries.name: extrude.set.region.nodes
entries.description: Get the list of 2D vectors wich correspond to the positions of the nodes of an element with local index i within a block with ID ib.

entries.name: extrude.set.zone.autodir
entries.description: The function only applies to 3D case (when 3D zones are generated from the Extruder).

entries.name: extrude.set.zone.count2
entries.description: Get the number of 2D elements (zones) in the xy plane.

entries.name: extrude.set.zone.count3
entries.description: The function only applies to 3D case (when 3D zones are generated from the Extruder).

entries.name: extrude.set.zone.target.edge
entries.description: Get/set the auto-zoning edge length. The default is 1.0.

entries.name: extrude.set.zone.target.size
entries.description: Get/set the autozoning size (number of zones). The default is 100.

entries.name: extrude.set.zone.target.total
entries.description: Get/set the auto-zoning total (number of zones). The default is 100.

renamed in 9.x: FLAC3D 7.0 name of the Extruder tool's FISH face (138 names). 9.x renamed the tool and the namespace to sketch.*: the 9.8 table lists no extrude.* at all, so these entries are 7.0-only. The command corpus keeps the two as one family (each sketch command's 7.0 block is spelled 'extrude ...').
